title: NASA experiment: tardigrades survive 18 months in the vacuum of space

tellings.quote:
NASA did an experiment
where they survived 18 months in the
vacuum of space.

plain: Tardigrades, microscopic animals often called water bears, survived 18 months in the vacuum of space in a NASA experiment outside the International Space Station. That is what a guest named Dr. Gilbert says on the show, without naming a source. He offers it as proof that life can be tough enough to survive in space.
